{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders, excluding QA orders
loyal_completed_real = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                             (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
                             (sales['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute mean revenue on real orders only
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_real['revenue'].mean()

# Confirm
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed real orders: {len(loyal_completed_real)}")
print(f"Mean revenue (excluding QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
